findings.details: [P3] Express interval validation bounds in the displayed unit. With Unit=minutes and Every=0.1, Save attaches 'Number must be greater than or equal to 30000' to Every. That number is milliseconds, but the field is measured in minutes, contradicting the nearby 30-second minimum and giving incorrect correction guidance. Actual controls reproduced this at 1440/900/390 with zero invalid mutation POSTs; 0.5 minutes saves once as 30000 ms. I inspected interval-units.js/log/summary, the 390 screenshot and matching source in the terminal fresh UI review at /tmp/interlock-236-ui-review-revision1/. Translate min/max bounds into the selected unit or state an explicit duration such as 'Use an interval of at least 30 seconds', retaining the field association. Preserve the externally assigned shared UI236-R5 ID across workflows as required by the coordinator. This predates the revision and was found within affected interval-validation recovery scope.
